title: Faster conversion of Point Cloud to Occupancy Grid and vice versa
abstract:
Faster conversion of Point Cloud to Occupancy Grid and vice versa

Open3D has implemented the voxelization of point clouds. Since Open3D has CUDA bindings, this would speed up converting point clouds to voxel grids.

Please refer to [Open3D Voxelization (Occupancy Grid) from Point Cloud](http://www.open3d.org/docs/latest/tutorial/Advanced/voxelization.html#From-point-cloud)

It is important to note that not all points in the Velodyne point cloud should be used to generate the grid. Only the points in the FOV of the camera must be used. The function `transform_points_to_occupancy_grid` implements this filter. We must see how we can run this filter in parallel or offload the logic.

https://github.com/PW22-SBN-01/kitti_iterator/blob/e89c5ec3313f92f18bc8c25352ccf0abce0f37fe/kitti_iterator/kitti_raw_iterator.py#L265-L346

Not sure if there is an existing implementation of the Grid to Point Cloud conversation (this conversion is required to render the occupancy grid). I have implemented a version of this in python, do look into the effectiveness and how we might optimize it further. 

https://github.com/PW22-SBN-01/kitti_iterator/blob/e89c5ec3313f92f18bc8c25352ccf0abce0f37fe/kitti_iterator/kitti_raw_iterator.py#L207-L235
